Company profile

Who we are

Since our founding in 2001, originally known as IBN AL BALAD and AL-SEROH AL SHAMIKHA (ASAS), Oasis Fajr has been a trusted name in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's contracting industry. With an unwavering commitment to excellence, we have continuously delivered successful projects that meet high standards of quality.

We continue to evolve with the demands of the industry, keeping our skills and capabilities current. Our work is guided by steady improvement rather than shortcuts, and by delivery that holds up after handover.

Oasis Fajr works across commercial, industrial, sports and infrastructure buildings, coordinating civil, mechanical, electrical and finishing work through an integrated project team.

Our general civil contracting scope covers concrete and steel structures, joinery and carpentry, high-quality finishing, prefabricated and modular building, demolition and earth moving, infrastructure services, pavement, dams and roads.

On the MEP side we handle mechanical, electrical, HVAC and plumbing works for residential, commercial and industrial buildings, including electrical design and installation to local regulations, and fire alarm installation, operation and maintenance according to NFPA and Saudi Civil Defense requirements.

Formerly known as IBN AL BALAD and AL-SEROH AL SHAMIKHA (ASAS), the company operates from Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Safety & Quality

Safety and quality at every stage

Safety, quality, and reliability guide our work from planning and material approval through site execution, inspection, and final handover.

  • Site safety supervision

    A designated Safety Officer, with supervisors and marshals, is responsible for implementing our HSE policy on site.

  • Material approval and verification

    Materials are submitted, approved and verified against specification before installation begins.

  • Quality inspections

    Work is inspected stage by stage so defects are caught while they are still inexpensive to correct.

  • Progress monitoring

    Programme, manpower and completed scope are tracked and reported against the agreed schedule.

  • Project documentation

    Job safety analyses, inspection records and site instructions are documented throughout the project.

  • Final testing and handover

    Systems are tested and commissioned, then handed over with the supporting records.

HSE policy

Health, safety and environment

We consider our employees our most precious resource, and the environment the best gift given to us. Every one of us is an important asset and their health and safety matters to us.

HSE features prominently in our planning process, where due consideration is given to creating a safe work environment for all our employees and other resources deployed. We practise "Target Zero Accidents": every one of us carries out job safety analysis before commencing an activity, evaluates work-related risks and takes proactive measures to mitigate them. The process is documented and gives every worker the right to stop work if it is found unsafe.

It is the aim and intention of Oasis Fajr Contracting to gradually reduce and eliminate environmental pollution and damage through effective control of waste production and atmospheric emissions.

Reportable environmental incidents

  • Spills
  • Water wastage
  • Presence of hazardous waste
  • Atmospheric emission in the form of dust, fumes or gas

Environmental commitments

  • Providing methods of work which are environmentally friendly, such as screening sites and reducing site traffic through residential areas.
  • Including the provision of appropriate environmental control in sub-contracts.
  • Choosing quiet machinery wherever possible.
  • Considering an informative public relations exercise before setting up site.
  • Making contact where necessary with local pressure groups or residential associations.
  • Ensuring our activity causes as little nuisance, inconvenience or disturbance to the public as possible, especially regarding existing structures, footpaths and traffic movements.

Quality policy

Our commitment to quality

We are committed to delivering projects with consistent quality that conform fully with company and statutory requirements, and meet our client's documented and implied expectations in terms of technical, budget and time compliance.

  • An efficient quality system built on accepted best practice in construction project management, keeping quality consistent and wastage minimal across all construction phases.
  • Evaluation, training and development of our employees in order to meet the company's objectives.
  • A corporate culture of constant problem solving and continuous improvement, encouraging all employees to take pride in and responsibility for their work.
  • Quality objectives at all levels that are realistic, achievable and measurable, including preventive action for outside influences.
  • Management communicates this policy to all employees and staff so that it is properly understood and followed.
